msContents.summary: [p]Collection of short treatises and extracts on alchemy, etc.: in Latin and Italian. A few small marginal pen drawings of alchemical apparatus, etc. On the first leaf is the signature of Saturnus à Canalibus in a contemporary hand. Above, in a later 17th century hand, 'Clarissima signora Elena Bonariz (?) figlia del Signor Franco'.[/p] Comprises the following works: [li](Anon.) Proba d'un Reverendo Padre donaata l'anno 1617[li]Mazzotta (Benedictus). De mineralibus, rebusque subterraneis aliisque arcanis chymicis[li]Bernhardus Trevisanus. Practica de lapide. Enigma. In Italian[li](Anon.) Trattato d'alcuni medicamenti spargirici (sic) e loro virtu e pre-parazione[li]Hoghelande (Theobald von). Secreta revelatio verae operationis manualis tam pro universali opere et lapide sapientum quam pro particularibus quibusdam[li](Anon.) In librum de potestate angelica. ad 206: Articulum sextum. An aurum fieri possit saltem a magis virtute Cacodaemonum?[li](Anon.) Trattato d'erbe secondo l'influssi de' pianeti[li]Abbatia (Antonius de). Ad mentem Reverendi Antonii Arcipresbytri de Abbatia (de lapide philosophico)[li]Lullius (Raymundus). Ordo mineralium secundum Raymundum[li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Extract from 'Alfabeto'[li]M.
